objective: Calculate actual operational metrics from M45 qualification testing

baseline_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that failed due to baseline issues

mutation_execution_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that completed mutation execution successfully
mutation_execution_metrics.notes: 2 campaigns timed out due to local performance constraints, not execution failures

infrastructure_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that failed due to infrastructure issues

timeout_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that timed out
timeout_metrics.notes: High timeout rate due to local performance constraints; expected to be lower in CI
timeout_metrics.root_cause: Some engine components have performance issues locally

invalid_execution_metrics.description: Percentage of mutants with invalid execution (not actually executed)

retry_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that required retries
retry_metrics.notes: No retryable failures encountered during testing

worker_metrics.description: Percentage of worker executions that failed

cache_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns that reused cache
cache_metrics.notes: Cache reuse testing was limited; expected to be higher in production use

cache_invalidation_metrics.description: Percentage of cache lookups that resulted in invalidation
cache_invalidation_metrics.notes: No stale cache detected during testing

resume_metrics.description: Percentage of interrupted campaigns that resumed successfully
resume_metrics.calculation: M45.6 interrupt/resume test — clean run 173/10, interrupted at RC=-15, resumed 173/10, 100% match

determinism_metrics.description: Percentage of replay attempts that produced identical results

evidence_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns with complete and valid evidence

configuration_metrics.description: Percentage of campaigns with valid configuration fingerprints

mutation_population_metrics.description: Percentage of expected mutation opportunities that are actually generated (production code only)
mutation_population_metrics.calculation: M45.14 L-ARCH-001 probe verified that mutmut 3.7.0 generates mutations for every Python syntax feature used in ClariFin_OS production code (PEP 604 union annotations: 586 occurrences in 139/242 files).

test_metrics.description: Average tests executed per minute (not directly measured)
test_metrics.calculation: Not directly measured in current campaigns
test_metrics.notes: Test execution metrics not separately tracked

worker_utilization_metrics.description: Average worker utilization during parallel execution

cpu_utilization_metrics.description: Average CPU utilization during mutation execution

memory_metrics.description: Average memory utilization during mutation execution

shard_metrics.description: Efficiency of sharded execution vs sequential
shard_metrics.notes: Sharding not tested locally; will be tested in CI

startup_overhead_metrics.description: Overhead time for mutation campaign startup

targeted_vs_full_metrics.description: Comparison of targeted vs full execution times
targeted_vs_full_metrics.notes: Full campaign execution deferred to CI

reliability_summary.description: Weighted average of all reliability metrics

performance_metrics_detailed.cache_benefit_observation: Minimal benefit locally (cache mainly helps CI reruns and warm pipelines)

threshold_requirements.evidence: Local timeouts (financial_events, loan_engine, behaviour_engine) deferred to CI per M45.22
100% evidence integrity; execution_path field present in all summaries
M45.14 probe — 100% coverage of used syntax

ci_dependencies: CI sharding of full campaign per M45.5 — deferred to M45.9

recommendations: Address timeout issues in CI environment
Add missing metrics collection (CPU, memory, worker utilization)
